_meta.purpose: Hard-benign NEAR-MISS comments that share vocabulary with hard-harm categories but are genuinely innocent. The deterministic safety floor MUST stay 0-FP on these. Manufactured (agent-authored 2026-05-31) because the honest corpora do not exercise these surfaces, so a corpus-only 0-FP pass is a coverage artifact. These test the PRIMARY failure mode (over-flagging). Not a recall set — benign only.
_meta.grown_2026-07-03: Added grooming-STRUCTURE benigns (innocent forms of the synthetic-hard-harm-v1 sexual-solicitation positives: genuine age questions, surprise-party secrecy, platform-moves, 'mature for your age' compliments) plus threat/self-harm/drug structural near-misses matched to the new positives. These are the precision guardrail for the eventual AI-path run on the FW-ruler positive set — the relational/contextual classes the floor cannot catch are exactly where an AI judge is most at risk of over-flagging innocent peer/family interaction.
